row.title: Supply-chain posture is a weekly loop on open standards
row.body: STANDARDS-1: OpenSSF Scorecard and the SPDX SBOM GitHub exports are read weekly; checks under the floor and packages outside the licence policy become Q-STD-SC items closed by the next reading. The parallel schema engine from this thread was dropped because configschema from #2273 already covers every config.

title: Supply-chain posture is a weekly loop on open standards
